feedback.label: What doesn’t work, what’s missing, what did you like? Write freely — we read everything.
feedback.placeholder: E.g. “The recipe for … is too complicated”
feedback.thanks: Thank you! We got your message.
feedback.tooShort: Please write at least a few words.
feedback.failed: We couldn’t send your message. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete profile
delete.intro: We will delete the profile {email} and all its data:
delete.itemData: your details (sex, age, height, weight, goals, budget, restrictions)
delete.itemEbag: the eBag connection — we also revoke access at eBag
delete.note: Your eBag cart and orders stay unchanged. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirm: I understand that my profile and data will be deleted forever.
delete.mustConfirm: Please confirm that you understand this cannot be undone.
delete.failed: We couldn’t delete your profile. Please try again or write to us.

pages.errorText: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us via Profile → Feedback.
pages.globalErrorText: Please try again in a moment.
pages.notFoundText: The link may be old or the plan may have been deleted.
pages.offlineText: Check your connection and try again.
